title.zh: 规定在卡加延省Solana市镇设立动物繁育站的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Animal Breeding Station in the Municipality of Solana, Province of Cagayan
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Animal Breeding Station in the Municipality of Solana, Province of Cagayan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4288_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Director of Animal Industry, an animal breeding station in the Municipality of Solana, Province of Cagayan.
The Director of Animal Industry shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said animal breeding station; said sum to be spent by the Director of Animal Industry, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, for the purchase of breeding animals, supplies and materials; for the construction of buildings, sheds, corrals and other structures; for the establishment of a water system; for the salaries and wages of personnel and such other expenses as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
